title: Price assurance
finding: Invented price-book coefficients produce a reproducible discrepancy.
implication: Review calculations and retain their inputs.

title: Evidence and authority
finding: Evidence checklists and reviewer personas are synthetic.
implication: Actual procurement authority is outside this demonstration.

title: Emergency timing
finding: Eight-hour contact and 24-hour documentation targets are fixture assumptions, not a jurisdiction policy.
implication: Record lateness without rewriting the event history.

title: Renewal readiness
finding: The 90-day notice term and performance checklist are illustrative contract assumptions.
implication: Read actual terms and owner-approved policy before integrating.

title: docusign May 2026 release notes
finding: The release notes describe Workflow Builder naming and capabilities including the HTTP web request extension and workflow variable features.
implication: Propose a typed request from Workflow Builder to PUG; confirm the sandbox entitlement, security options and response mapping before connecting.

title: Agreement Manager API FAQ
finding: The vendor describes API access to agreement ingestion and querying, with developer testing and production plan considerations.
implication: Use agreement metadata as reviewable evidence. Fixture math and checkboxes in this example do not prove extraction quality or a live IAM connection.

title: Configure agreement types and fields
finding: Configuration packages support agreement types, fields and extraction configuration; changes can affect existing configuration and require reprocessing for existing agreements.
implication: Version configuration, test on a dedicated synthetic corpus and review a dry run. Never bulk-overwrite a shared tenant as part of this demo.
